description: A statewide association of municipal attorneys has named state Rep. Kristin Kassner its Legislator of the Year, an honor the group hasn’t given out in seven years, according to a news release from Kassner’s office. The Massachusetts Municipal Lawyers Association (MMLA) presented the award to Kassne
paid_for_by: Paid for by The Committee to Elect Kristin Kassner
title: Municipal Lawyers group Honors Rep. Kassner as Legislator of The Year, Its First Since 2019 — Kristin Kassner for State Representative
